Documentation Concern

  • CURIE: gmeow:DocumentationConcern
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/DocumentationConcern
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/kernel
  • Box roles: TBox role (What is this?)

A cross-cutting documentation theme generated into its own guide page. Terms opt into a concern with gmeow:docsConcern so adoption-oriented docs are ontology-backed, not a private renderer taxonomy.

Structure

Subclass of: gufo:QualityValue

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:DocumentationConcern as a specialized kind of gufo:QualityValue. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use to declare a cross-cutting documentation theme that terms from many slices opt into, so a generated guide page is backed by the graph rather than by a private renderer taxonomy.

Avoid when

  • Avoid creating a concern for a single slice's local narrative (that belongs in its docs.md guide) and avoid per-concern subclasses; concerns are individuals referenced by gmeow:docsConcern.

How to use

  • Mint the concern as an individual, then annotate participating terms with gmeow:docsConcern pointing at it; the documentation generator collects them into one themed page.

Examples

  • gmeow:coarsenTo gmeow:docsConcern gmeow:concernDisclosure.
